de1.P1.C10.explanation: Hinh chieu song song cua hai duong thang song song la hai duong thang song song hoac trung nhau.
de1.P1.C10.ly_do: Dap an C dung theo dinh ly hinh chieu song song; loi giai luu toan cong thuc tang khong lien quan nen thay bang loi giai dung.

de1.P1.C11.explanation: Ta thay tan so lon nhat cua mau so lieu da cho la 90, suy ra nhom chua Mot la nhom $\left[ 0;1 \right)$.
de1.P1.C11.ly_do: Nhan xet mot trong loi giai la dung (tan so lon nhat 90 thuoc nhom [0;1)); doan sau ve ham cos la noi dung cau khac bi dinh vao nen cat bo, giu nguyen dap an A.

de1.P1.C9.explanation: Trong khong gian, hai duong thang duoc goi la song song neu chung cung nam trong mot mat phang va khong co diem chung.
de1.P1.C9.ly_do: Dap an C dung theo dinh nghia hai duong thang song song; loi giai luu toan manh sin/cos khong lien quan nen thay bang loi giai dung.

de1.P2.C17.ly_do: Da tinh lai: nghiem la -pi/12+kpi va pi/4+kpi; tren [-2pi;5pi] co 7+7=14 nghiem nen tf_ans D,S,D,S khop.

de1.P2.C18.ly_do: Da tinh lai: u_n=-7n+12; u_11=-65, u_5+u_7=-60, -849 ung n=123, -114 ung n=18 nen tf_ans D,S,D,D khop.

de1.P2.C19.ly_do: Da tinh lai: lim x->-2 bang -4, lim trai tai -1 bang -3, lim phai bang can 2 nen khong ton tai gioi han tai -1; tf_ans S,D,D,S khop.

de1.P2.C20.ly_do: Da tinh lai: trung binh 1,016; nhom chua mot la [1;1,05); Q1 xap xi 0,98; Q3 xap xi 1,048 nen tf_ans D,S,D,S khop.
